currentContext.business: The Company operates a casting and foundry manufacturing business serving industrial and infrastructure end-users, and is working towards operational stabilization and revival of manufacturing activities following implementation of the approved Resolution Plan. Following the induction of new management, it diversified into the winery and beverages sector and is presently engaged in the manufacturing, processing, bottling, trading, importing, exporting and distribution of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The diversification was formalised by an alteration of the Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association approved by Members via Special Resolution at the AGM held on 30 September 2025, and by the acquisition of Oniv Beverages Private Limited during the year.

currentContext.expansion: The Company discloses no plant-level capacity addition, commissioning, debottlenecking or greenfield project in this Annual Report. Expansion during FY2025-26 was entirely inorganic and structural: following implementation of the NCLT-approved Resolution Plan and the induction of a new promoter and management team, the Company diversified into the winery and beverages sector and acquired Oniv Beverages Private Limited, which the MD&A describes as its entry into a rapidly growing consumer-oriented business segment expected to strengthen revenue streams. The enabling step was legal rather than physical — Members approved by Special Resolution at the AGM of 30 September 2025 an alteration of Clause III (Object Clause) of the Memorandum of Association to permit manufacturing, processing, bottling, trading, importing, exporting and distribution of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and the requisite statutory filings have been completed. On the manufacturing side the stated intent is revival rather than expansion: the Company continued efforts towards operational stabilization and revival of manufacturing activities and remains focused on strengthening its position in casting and foundry through operational efficiencies, customer retention and market expansion, with adoption of automation and technology-driven manufacturing processes and expansion into new customer segments and geographical markets listed only as opportunities. Forward intent in beverages is product portfolio expansion, strengthening distribution networks and exploring new market opportunities — no site, capacity, rupee outlay or commissioning date is attached to any of it.

risks.risk: Statutory-filing and corporate-record failures flagged by the auditor
risks.note: The auditor's Emphasis of Matter draws attention to three separate items where shareholder-approved corporate actions were not completed for want of filings: the change of name and the shifting of the registered office from West Bengal to the NCT of Delhi were not completed because the requisite statutory forms were not filed with the ROC (and, for the shifting, the necessary petition was not filed before the Regional Director); and the alteration of authorised share capital, though approved by shareholders, was not given effect to for want of filing documents with the ROC, with the consequence that master data was not updated. This is a recurring compliance-hygiene failure at the corporate-secretarial layer, not a one-off.

risks.risk: Speculative transactions unconnected with the principal business
risks.note: The auditor draws attention to Note 23.1, which describes that the Company had entered into certain speculative transactions during the year which were not directly connected with its principal business activities. Capital deployed outside the stated business is a governance and capital-allocation risk for a company still stabilising after insolvency.

risks.risk: Unclaimed dividend not transferred to the IEPF
risks.note: The auditor draws attention to Note 10.1 regarding unclaimed dividend of Rs 1.42 Lakh which was required to be transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund — small in amount but another instance of an unmet statutory obligation.

risks.risk: Integration and execution risk on newly acquired businesses, alongside an incomplete acquisition
risks.note: Management explicitly lists integration and execution risks associated with newly acquired businesses among its risks and concerns. The Board's Report records a Share Purchase Agreement with the existing shareholders of Oniv Beverages Private Limited for 100% of its equity, for consideration not exceeding Rs 5.00 Crores to be discharged through issuance and allotment of the Company's equity shares, subject to all requisite statutory, regulatory and corporate approvals, and expected to complete during FY2026-27 — so as of the report date the Company still had no subsidiary, joint venture or associate and the diversification is contingent on approvals it has not yet received.

risks.risk: Regulatory and state-specific licensing risk in the beverage business
risks.note: Management flags changes in government policies and regulations, regulatory changes affecting manufacturing and beverage businesses, and state-specific licensing and compliance requirements in the beverage industry. Alcohol is a state-licensed trade and the Company is entering it from a standing start, having only altered its Object Clause during the year and being still occupied with establishing the operational and regulatory framework for the new line of business.

risks.risk: Raw material and energy cost volatility in the foundry business
risks.note: Management flags raw material and energy cost fluctuations, specifically volatility in prices of pig iron, scrap, ferro alloys, fuel and power — the dominant input cost base of a casting and foundry operation, with competitive and pricing pressure limiting pass-through.

Management lists working capital and liquidity management challenges among its risks and concerns — a live constraint for a company that is still pursuing operational stabilization and revival of manufacturing activities following implementation of the approved Resolution Plan.

risks.risk: Post-insolvency turnaround risk: revival is not yet demonstrated
risks.note: The NCLT-approved Resolution Plan brought capital restructuring, a change in management and control and a new promoter; the Company is still in the phase of operational revival, strengthening governance frameworks and restoring stakeholder confidence, and simultaneously pivoting into an unrelated consumer category. Competitive pressure and pricing challenges, economic slowdown affecting industrial demand, and supply chain and logistics disruption are all flagged against a business that has not yet re-established a stable operating base.
